Every Python example script consumed by sphinx-gallery must contain a valid reStructuredText title in its module-level docstring (e.g. `""".. _my-label:

My Title
========

Description...
"""`). sphinx-gallery requires this title to process the file; a script without one will cause the gallery build to fail.

The sphinx-gallery source examples directory (set via `examples_dirs` in `sphinx_gallery_conf` in `doc/conf.py`) must be placed *outside* the `doc/` tree — the project root `examples/` directory is the conventional location. Placing it inside `doc/` causes Sphinx to complain about `.rst` stub files (e.g. `README.rst`, `GALLERY_HEADER.rst`) that are not listed in any toctree.

When adding `sphinx-gallery` to the `docs` optional-dependencies in `pyproject.toml`, specify a minimum version of `>=0.17.0`. The default gallery-header filename changed from `README.rst` to `GALLERY_HEADER.rst` in that release; without the pin, installs of older versions will silently ignore `GALLERY_HEADER.rst`.
